description.en: Sets the scale of the Special Move map (CMND_GET_WAZA_MAP_HANDLE) with CMND_SET_SCALE, 0.45 by default. The in-match scenes call it after StartScEvent; ToScaleWazaMap scales coordinates the same way.
Scale to apply (1.0 restores the normal size).

examples.case: At the start of an in-match scene (real usage, from ev43030000.nut)
Back to normal size at the end (real usage, from ev44010020.nut)
